groups.description: The company this domain is modeled on: Kitry (Belgium), backed by Vortex Capital Partners since March 2022.

links.title: Kitry — occupational health and safety software
links.relevance: The vendor's own positioning: 35+ years of expertise, 4M+ employee records, 6,000+ active users, 50%+ self-service adoption, HDS and ISO 27001, the five modules and the named blue-chip and public-sector references behind the personas.

links.title: Kitry — implementation, support and HDS/ISO 27001 SaaS hosting
links.relevance: The four-phase implementation, data migration, change management, dedicated account managers and the shared versus dedicated SaaS hosting with no access from outside the EEA that shape the service manager's and consultant's journeys.

links.title: Kitry — Vortex investment page
links.relevance: The investor's description: 150+ organisations, more than 2.5 million medical files, ISO 45001 support, target sectors and the transition to a pure-play SaaS provider that frames the strategy horizons.

groups.description: Kitry module pages that the product bricks and streams mirror.

links.title: Kitry — Module Santé au travail
links.relevance: Unified medical file, online booking with SMS reminders, web questionnaires, secure teleconsultation with integrated signature, connected measurement devices, HR synchronisation and consultation-summarising AI — the occupational health bricks.

links.title: Kitry — Module Sécurité au travail
links.relevance: Configurable risk assessment, workstations with risks and PPE, homogeneous exposure groups, hazardous situation tracking, chemical inventory with safety data sheets and measurement campaigns — the workplace safety bricks.

groups.description: The French texts that define the medical file, surveillance periodicity, the risk assessment document and health-data hosting.

links.title: Loi n° 2021-1018 du 2 août 2021 pour renforcer la prévention en santé au travail
links.relevance: The law that defines the DMST, creates the prevention passport, requires interoperable occupational health information systems by 1 January 2024 and sets the 40-year DUERP retention — the regulatory content the platform must implement.

links.title: Décret n° 2022-1434 du 15 novembre 2022 relatif au dossier médical en santé au travail
links.relevance: DMST content, access and delegation rules with traced actions, the worker's right to oppose, 40-year retention, approved hosting and transfer between services — the specification of the medical file and confidentiality bricks.

links.title: INRS — Document unique d'évaluation des risques professionnels : quelles obligations ?
links.relevance: Who must keep a DUERP, annual updates, 40-year versioned retention, transmission to the occupational health service and the PAPRIPACT action programme — the HSE manager's core obligations.

links.title: Agence du Numérique en Santé — Certification des Hébergeurs de données de Santé (HDS)
links.relevance: What HDS certification covers, its three-year validity with annual surveillance audits and its relationship to ISO 27001 — the hosting requirement behind the service manager's procurement checklist.

groups.description: The Belgian well-being-at-work framework and the occupational disease agency.

links.title: FPS Employment — External service for prevention and protection at work
links.relevance: How Belgian external services are organised (risk management and health supervision sections, accreditation, ISO 9001) and why Kitry targets organisations with internal services while treating external services as substitutes and partners.

links.title: Fedris — Introduire une demande de maladie professionnelle
links.relevance: The claim forms (501/503 private sector, 601/603 local administrations), the mandatory medical certificate and the optional employer exposure attestation that the national reporting connectors must produce.

groups.description: The management-system standard customers certify against and the European accident statistics they benchmark on.

links.title: ISO 45001:2018 — Occupational health and safety management systems
links.relevance: The management-system standard Kitry helps customers achieve and maintain; the safety module's risk assessment, action plans and audits are the evidence base for certification.

links.title: Eurostat — Accidents at work statistics (ESAW)
links.relevance: EU-wide non-fatal and fatal accident counts, incidence rates per 100,000 employed and sector shares for 2023 — the benchmarks behind frequency and severity dashboards.

groups.description: Where occupational health buyers, prevention services and vendors meet in France and Belgium.

links.title: Préventica — salons santé, sécurité et qualité de vie au travail
links.relevance: The French trade show held twice a year under Ministry of Labour patronage where HSE managers, HR directors and occupational health services discover vendors — a discovery channel in the customer journeys.
